verdict.rationale: Databricks offers scriptable automation surfaces: a CLI for terminal and automation scripts, a Python SDK to automate operations, workspace REST APIs, and SQL, CLI and REST access to Unity Catalog objects. It also runs batch computation over large datasets, so operating across many items at once is achievable by scripting loops or set-based SQL. However, no evidence documents a dedicated bulk or batch operation capability such as multi-object edits or batch API endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented bulk/batch operations feature or API, examples of acting on many workspace objects in one call, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
